'''Arack "Deadeye" Dostryt''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who served as [[Director of Recruiting]] for the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Bounty Hunters' Guild]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Dostryt authored a chapter of the ''[[Bounty Hunters Guild Handbook]]'' which detailed the requirements for how prospective [[Hunting/Legends|hunters]] could gain admission into the guild and explained possible motivations for becoming a guild-affiliated [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] hunter.<ref name="Files of Boba Fett" />
